params.liquidationBonus: Bonus collateral awarded to liquidators in basis points                            (e.g. 500 = 5%). Must be ≤ 2000.
params.liquidationThreshold: Threshold at which vaults become liquidatable, in basis points                            (e.g. 8500 = 85%). Must be ≤ BASIS_POINTS (100%).
params.maxLTV: Maximum loan-to-value in basis points (e.g. 8000 = 80%).                            Must be strictly less than `liquidationThreshold`.
params.token: ERC-20 token address to whitelist as collateral.
params.tokenDecimals: Native ERC-20 decimal places of the token (e.g. 18 for WETH).

params.owner_: Initial contract owner (Ownable). Typically the deployer or a timelock.

returns._0: Array of collateral token addresses in registration order.
Full CollateralConfig struct for the token.
True if the token is whitelisted and not disabled; false otherwise.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.liquidationBonus: New liquidation bonus in basis points.
params.liquidationThreshold: New liquidation threshold in basis points.
params.maxLTV: New maximum LTV in basis points. Must be < liquidationThreshold.
params.token: ERC-20 token address of the collateral to update.

addCollateral(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Register a new collateral token with its risk parameters.         Reverts if the token is already registered (use updateCollateral for changes).         Enforces maxLTV < liquidationThreshold ≤ 100% and liquidationBonus ≤ 20%.         Only callable by the contract owner.

collateralList(uint256).notice: Ordered list of all collateral token addresses ever added (including disabled).         Used by VaultEngine to iterate over tokens when computing vault values.

collaterals(address).notice: Risk configuration for each collateral token address.

constructor.notice: Deploy the CollateralManager with no collateral tokens registered.         Add tokens via addCollateral() after deployment.

disableCollateral(address).notice: Disable a collateral token to prevent new deposits.         Existing vault positions that hold this token are NOT automatically closed.         VaultEngine will still price and liquidate existing positions; users can repay         and withdraw the disabled token at any time.         Only callable by the contract owner.

getCollateralList().notice: Return the ordered list of all collateral token addresses ever registered         (including disabled tokens). VaultEngine iterates this list to compute vault values.

getConfig(address).notice: Return the full risk configuration for a collateral token.         Returns a zero-initialised struct (enabled=false) for unregistered tokens.

isEnabled(address).notice: Check whether a collateral token is currently enabled for new deposits.

updateCollateral(address,uint256,uint256.notice: Update risk parameters for an already-registered collateral token.         tokenDecimals is immutable — the token's decimal count cannot change.         Enforces maxLTV < liquidationThreshold (same constraint as addCollateral).         Only callable by the contract owner.
